sets.title: Why Plants and Animals Do That
sets.titleEs: Por qué plantas y animales hacen eso

learn.model: 🌱 Plants grow because they get sun and water.
learn.notice: After because, we find the reason.

items.prompt: Which reason ends the sunflower sentence?
items.text: 🌻 The sunflower turns to the sun because ...
items.why: Needing light is the reason it turns. Because tells the reason.
items.whyEs: Necesitar luz es la razón por la que gira. Because dice la razón.

items.prompt: Which reason ends the ice sentence?
items.why: Warm air is the reason ice melts.
items.whyEs: El aire tibio es la razón por la que el hielo se derrite.

items.prompt: Which reason ends the puddle sentence?
items.why: Rain adds water, so the puddle grows. Rain is the reason.
items.whyEs: La lluvia agrega agua, así que el charco crece. La lluvia es la razón.

items.model: 🐻 Bears sleep in winter because food is hard to find.
items.why: Because tells why bears sleep in winter.
items.whyEs: Because dice por qué duermen los osos en invierno.

items.prompt: Check every sentence with a good reason.

options.text: 🌵 Cacti save water because deserts are dry.
🌵 Cacti save water because they are green.
🐟 Fish breathe in water because they have gills.
🐟 Fish breathe in water because they have fur.

items.why: A good reason explains why. Dry places and gills explain the facts.
items.whyEs: Una buena razón explica por qué. Los lugares secos y las branquias explican los hechos.

items.prompt: Which reason ends the leaf sentence?
items.why: Cooler weather is the reason leaves fall.
items.whyEs: El clima más fresco es la razón por la que caen las hojas.

write.prompt: Finish the sentence out loud with because. Tell a reason.
write.promptEs: Termina la oración en voz alta con because. Di una razón.

label: It sounds like a whole sentence
Suena como una oración completa

write.model: Plants need water because water helps them grow.

familyTalk.en: While watering a plant, say: 'We water the plant because ...'
familyTalk.es: Mientras riegan una planta, digan: 'We water the plant because ...'

teacherTip.en: Have partners say the stem and ending aloud. Clap on because so children hear the reason coming.
teacherTip.es: Pide que las parejas digan el comienzo y el final en voz alta. Aplaude en because para anunciar la razón.

learn.model: 🚲 A bike is slow, but it does not need gas.

items.prompt: Which ending shows a surprise for the map?
items.why: A small map showing a big place is a surprise. But shows a surprise.
items.whyEs: Un mapa pequeño que muestra un lugar grande es una sorpresa. But muestra una sorpresa.

items.prompt: Which ending shows a surprise for the old house?
items.text: 🏠 Long ago, houses had no lights, but today ...
items.why: Then and now are different. But shows the change.
items.whyEs: Antes y ahora son diferentes. But muestra el cambio.

items.prompt: Which ending shows a surprise for the farmer?
items.why: Hard work with a big reward is a surprise. But shows it.
items.whyEs: Un trabajo duro con una gran recompensa es una sorpresa. But la muestra.

items.model: 🌉 The old bridge is plain, but it is very strong.
items.why: But shows a surprise: plain, yet strong.
items.whyEs: But muestra una sorpresa: sencillo, pero fuerte.

items.prompt: Check every sentence that uses but for a surprise.

options.text: 🚲 The bike is small, but it can carry two bags.
🚲 The bike is small, so it fits in the hall.
🚌 The bus is full, but one more child gets on.
🚌 The bus is full, so we wait.

items.why: But shows a surprise. The so sentences show a result.
items.whyEs: But muestra una sorpresa. Las oraciones con so muestran un resultado.

items.prompt: Which ending shows a surprise for the boat?
items.why: A slow boat that carries many boxes is a surprise.
items.whyEs: Un barco lento que carga muchas cajas es una sorpresa.

write.prompt: Finish the sentence out loud with but. Tell a surprise.
write.promptEs: Termina la oración en voz alta con but. Di una sorpresa.

label: It sounds like a whole sentence
Suena como una oración completa

write.model: The bus is slow, but it is safe.

familyTalk.en: Look at something in your town. Finish: 'It is old, but ...'
familyTalk.es: Miren algo en su pueblo. Terminen: 'It is old, but ...'

teacherTip.en: Ask partners to say the first idea, then the surprise. Use two different hand motions for the two ideas.
teacherTip.es: Pide que las parejas digan la primera idea y luego la sorpresa. Usa dos gestos diferentes para las dos ideas.

learn.model: 🦷 Sam brushes his teeth, so they stay clean.
learn.notice: After so, we find the result.

items.prompt: Which result ends the hand-washing sentence?
items.why: Clean hands mean germs wash away. That is the result.
items.whyEs: Las manos limpias hacen que los gérmenes se vayan. Ese es el resultado.

items.prompt: Which result ends the bedtime sentence?
items.text: 😴 Leo goes to bed early, so ...
items.why: Sleep helps us feel rested. That is the result.
items.whyEs: Dormir nos ayuda a sentirnos descansados. Ese es el resultado.

items.prompt: Which result ends the fruit sentence?
items.why: Fruit gives the body vitamins. That is the result.
items.whyEs: La fruta le da vitaminas al cuerpo. Ese es el resultado.

items.model: 🏃 We run at recess, so our bodies get strong.
items.why: So tells the result: running makes bodies strong.
items.whyEs: So dice el resultado: correr fortalece el cuerpo.

items.prompt: Check every sentence that uses so for a result.

options.text: 🧴 Ben wears sunscreen, so his skin stays safe.
🧴 Ben wears sunscreen because the sun is strong.
💧 Jo drinks water, so she feels fresh.
💧 Jo drinks water, but she is still thirsty.

items.why: So comes before the result. Because and but do other jobs.
items.whyEs: So va antes del resultado. Because y but hacen otros trabajos.

items.prompt: Which result ends the cold air sentence?
items.why: Cold air means we wear warm coats. That is the result.
items.whyEs: El aire frío hace que usemos abrigos. Ese es el resultado.

write.prompt: Finish the sentence out loud with so. Tell the result.
write.promptEs: Termina la oración en voz alta con so. Di el resultado.

label: It sounds like a whole sentence
Suena como una oración completa

write.model: I am hungry, so I eat lunch.

familyTalk.en: At home, finish together: 'It is very hot, so we ...'
familyTalk.es: En casa, terminen juntos: 'It is very hot, so we ...'

teacherTip.en: Have children say the first idea, step forward on so, then say the result.
teacherTip.es: Pide que digan la primera idea, den un paso en so y digan el resultado.
